description: Import a video file's frames as layers of a new document, optionally as a frame animation (File > Import > Video Frames to Layers)

endTime.description: Import up to this time. Default the end

frames.description: Frames on top of the seconds, at the timeline's frame rate

file.description: Absolute path of the video file

frameRate.description: The video's frame rate, which the frames in startTime and endTime count in. Default 30

frameSkip.description: Keep every Nth frame (Limit To Every N Frames)

makeAnimation.description: Make a frame animation from the layers. Default false

startTime.description: Import from this time. Default the start

frames.description: Frames on top of the seconds, at the timeline's frame rate

name: import_video_frames
title: Import Video Frames
